report_requirement: Expose these two assurance levels in the independent report; do not call the full dynamics numerically independently reconstructed. This clarifies interfaces35 wording and retains the established C27 cache-based dynamics proof scope.
partial_records: If a hard gate stops the attempt, independently inspect actual saved partial records and their real attempted/returned/checked counts, retain the first failure evidence, and mark the campaign unqualified/incomplete.
